widgets_values: A cinematic static shot of a futuristic trading card rotating slowly in place. The background is dark with ambient neon glows and soft light rays streaming from above. The card is thick and premium, with beveled edges and subtle glossy reflections that react to the rotating motion. As the card turns, light dances across its surface, highlighting the glow of text and graphical elements. The floor beneath the card shows a soft, diffused reflection. The rotation is smooth and continuous, completing a full 360-degree spin on the vertical axis, then seamlessly looping back to the start. No camera movement—only the card rotates, creating an elegant, endless loop
